title: G7 · 接受
body: I replaced three independent bottlenecks while leaving the proven matrix and other fast paths untouched: bounded integer dedupe now uses a direct stamp table and the general Set fallback needs only one probe, word-frequency selection sorts only the relevant cutoff groups, and primes use a segmented odd-only sieve with persistent base-prime cursors. Even conservative gains of 1.50×, 1.15×, and 1.25× project to about 43.1× versus the 39.0× champion, while historical odd-sieve measurements support a larger prime gain, so this should clear the 5% acceptance threshold.
